name: Siding contractor

pf.license.need: if: a siding, contractor or home improvement license or registration for the company, where the state's form requires one (some states license siding on its own, some under a general contractor or home improvement license, some not at all)
ask: The company's license or registration number, and its class
Any job-size limit the license has
General liability insurance; workers' comp where the business has employees
A bond, where the state's form asks for one
pf.license.holder: The business; plus a qualifying person where the state's form names one. A window installer holds their own license where the state asks.
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
blocks: No siding work goes live until the company's license checks out, where one is required
A job over the license's size limit is never offered or quoted: the owner is told why
pf.license.declared_emergency: In a declared emergency, the owner says which licenses in that area have lapsed, and a siding contractor new to the state is held until the owner says yes, where the state's rules say so
pf.license.renewals: License, insurance and bond dates kept; reminded 30 days out; a lapse pauses new bookings
pf.license.lead_safe: Work that disturbs painted siding or trim on older homes only by a firm and a person certified for lead-safe work, where the rules require it
pf.license.asbestos: Old cement-board siding that may hold asbestos is never cut, broken or sanded by the crew. Testing and licensed removal come first, where the rules require it.
pf.license.showroom: The showroom: a registration, and a salesperson's registration for each consultant who sells siding work, only where the state's form asks
pf.license.background: Background checks only where the state's form asks

pf.services.pattern: Inspection, then project: new siding is booked only after a written estimate and a signed contract

B.name: Siding inspection and estimate

B.before: nothing taken (or a card saved for the $89 fee)
B.after: billed only if no contract follows

B.where: at the customer's place; nobody needs to be home on work days
B.before: nothing at booking; a deposit only after the contract is signed
B.after: the balance after the final walk-around, and the city's final inspection where the permit requires it

B.where: added to a new siding job, never booked alone

B.before: nothing, or a card saved for the $89 fee

B.where: at the customer's place; nobody needs to be home
B.before: a card saved for the $89 fee

B.where: at the customer's place; nobody needs to be home

B.before: a written contract where the state's rules require one, then a 25% deposit

B.before: nothing taken, or a card saved for the $89 fee
B.after: Rosie texts the bill; the report is sent the same day or the next

B.name: Siding check on a plan

pf.services.capacity: One estimator or consultant per booking; one crew per job, up to 25 squares in 3 days; the showroom's layout table is saved with long sessions
pf.services.skills: Inspections and estimates: estimators. Installs: crew leads with their crews. Windows: licensed installers. Showroom: consultants.
pf.services.nobody_home: Siding work outside: nobody needs to be home; a start photo and day-end photos. An adult is needed only for the 5-minute look inside at the inspection.
pf.services.online: No video consult: color picks use the sample boards at the showroom

before_times: What's wrong: storm or hail damage, cracked or loose boards, water getting in, or an old house?
What is the siding made of now: vinyl, wood, fiber cement or aluminum?
About how old is the siding?
How many stories is the house?
Is any wall wet or stained inside now?
after_time: Have you filed an insurance claim? Yes or no only, never the claim's details
The year the home was built (painted siding on older homes may need lead-safe work, where the rules require it)
OK to put a ladder against the walls and take photos?
Will an adult be home for a 5-minute look inside?
Gate, pets and parking (the crew needs room for a truck and a ladder)
Do you own the home or rent? (the owner signs any contract)
Is the home in an owners' association or a historic district? (some need approval before a new color or material)
secure_page_only: The association's or district's approval letter, if the home needs one
pf.questions.who_may_book: An adult who owns the home, or someone with the owner's written OK. Everyone on the home's title signs a siding contract. A renter may book an inspection only with the owner's OK.
showroom: Which part of the house: the siding, the trim or the shutters
Photos of the house, and an old board if there is one (optional)

stop.words: a tree or limb through a wall, power lines down on or near the house
stop.says: Leave the house and stay far from the lines. Then call 911 and the power company.
stop.booking: no booking until the house is safe

stop.words: a wall bulging, leaning or pulling away from the house
stop.says: Get everyone out of the rooms by that wall, and call 911 if anyone is at risk.

stop.words: a gas smell, sparking or smoking wires
stop.says: Leave the house now. Then call 911 and the gas or power company.

steps_then_go_on.words: water coming through a wall or a window, a wet or stained inside wall
steps_then_go_on.says: Keep everyone away from the wet wall and any outlet near it, and catch the drips in a bucket. Turn that room off at the breaker only if it's safe to reach. Don't climb a ladder to look.
steps_then_go_on.booking: goes on, marked urgent; the soonest inspection time is offered first

steps_then_go_on.words: siding hanging loose or flapping in the wind
steps_then_go_on.says: Keep people and pets away from it. Don't climb a ladder to fix it.
steps_then_go_on.booking: goes on, marked urgent; the soonest inspection time is offered first

pf.safety.business_line: Questions about whether a wall is safe, or about the structure, go to the business's own line
pf.safety.never: Customers are told never to climb a ladder to look at or fix siding

pf.first_steps.before_quote: The inspection at the home: each wall, the boards and the sheathing where they are loose, photos by wall, squares measured
after_contract: The cancel window ends before any work or orders, where the state's rules give one

The permit, where the rules require one, pulled by the license holder in the business's name; any owners' association or historic approval the home needs; and any notice the state's rules require before work starts
Siding, trim and house wrap delivered the day before the first work day
A dry, calm forecast for the first work day
prep: An adult home for the 5-minute look inside at the inspection
Before the work: move grills, planters and chairs 5 feet from the walls, trim back bushes, move cars from the driveway, and keep pets inside
showroom_prep: Bring an old board or a paint chip, if there is one
pf.first_steps.sample_pickup: A 15-minute sample pickup before a full exterior plan, at least 2 days before, so the boards are seen on the house in daylight

pf.visit.check_in: Inspection: the check-in code at the door, with an adult home for the look inside. Work days: nobody needs to be home; the crew texts a start photo. Showroom: the code at the desk.
pf.visit.at_the_visit: The walls are checked from the ground and from a ladder only when it's dry and calm. Photos of each wall, a moisture reading where boards are loose, squares measured. The written report and estimate come the same day, good for 30 days. Nothing is signed or paid at the inspection.
pf.visit.bad_weather: No ladder work in rain, ice or high wind: inspect from the ground and from inside, or move the time
pf.visit.changes: Rotted sheathing at the contract's price per sheet, up to the count OK'd in the contract, with photos and a change order for the record. Past it, a signed change order before that work.
pf.visit.work_days: Plants, the AC unit and grills covered or moved; a wall is never left open overnight (wrapped the same day); a magnet sweep of the yard, driveway and flower beds for nails, with photos; day-end photos to the customer
pf.visit.outside_checks: The city's final inspection, where the permit requires it
pf.visit.done: The final inspection where needed, then the walk-around and nail sweep, then DONE
pf.visit.showroom_done: DONE after the consult, with the picks saved for the inspection and estimate
pf.visit.before_photos: Each wall, the damaged boards and any inside stains

pf.money.inspection: The example's $89 inspection counts toward the siding work, and is billed only if no contract follows. A free inspection is a safe start.
pf.money.no_money_before_contract: On new siding, nothing is taken before the contract is signed by everyone
pf.money.deposit: Only after signing; the deposit cap comes from the state's form
pf.money.kept_apart: Money paid before the work is kept apart or bonded where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state's form)
pf.money.balance: After the final walk-around, and the city's final inspection where the permit requires it; never ahead of the work
pf.money.insurance: The customer's own insurance claim pays the customer, never through Rosie or the business. The deductible is always the customer's: never paid, waived or rebated.
pf.money.insurance_check: If the balance waits for the insurer's check, Sam picks: wait, or call
pf.money.storm_prices: In a declared emergency, prices stay at the list from before it, for as long as the state's rules say
pf.money.rosfield_fee: Rosfield's $2 can be switched off by state and by who pays, where a state's rule on pay for referrals reaches it (a switch from the state's form, for counsel to confirm)
pf.money.big_bills: Bank transfer through the company's own Stripe, for bills over the owner's amount (the example: $500); paid once it clears. A check also works: the crew lead texts 'paid check'.
pf.money.tax: Tax on materials and labor follows the state's form
pf.money.showroom: The color preview session's $55 counts toward the siding if Alex signs with Lee Siding; the $20 missed-consult fee only after Sam OKs it

never_in_texts: Contract, change order and permit papers (secure page only, with a copy by email)
pf.messages.minors: Never booked by a minor; a child at home never lets the crew in
pf.messages.no_claim_ads: No text ever urges anyone to file an insurance claim

pf.staff.roles: Estimators and crew leads (Tomas, Wes): inspections, estimates, and installs with their crews. Showroom consultants (Priya, Leo).
pf.staff.licenses: The company holds the siding or contractor license; window installers hold their own where the state asks, checked before they're named on a job
pf.staff.lead_safe: A certified renovator on any job that disturbs painted siding or trim on an older home, where lead-safe rules apply
pf.staff.who_oks: Sam OKs quotes and change orders over $500; Pat may OK them too, and Sam's answer wins
pf.staff.stand_in: Another estimator may take an inspection; an install keeps its crew lead unless Sam moves it
pf.staff.on_call: None: every job is booked ahead

pf.rules.contract: A written contract for new siding where the state's rules require one, signed by everyone on title and by the business before any money
pf.rules.contract_parts: The parts the state's form lists (license number, price, dates, deposit, cancel notice, any lien or recovery-fund notice, who owes the deductible)
pf.rules.cancel_window: A cancel window after signing, where the state's rules give one; a longer one for contracts signed in a declared emergency, where the rules say so. Work and orders wait for it.
pf.rules.claim_denied: A contract signed before the insurer decides: any right to cancel after a written denial, where the state's rules give one
pf.rules.insurance_claims: The business never files, adjusts or explains the customer's claim, unless the state's rules allow it; no gifts or rebates tied to an inspection or a claim
pf.rules.permits: Pulled by the license holder in the business's name, never the homeowner's, where the rules require one
pf.rules.approvals: An owners' association or historic approval comes from the owner before work starts, where the home needs one
pf.rules.notice_before_work: Any notice the state's rules require before work starts, filed by the owner of the business
pf.rules.change_orders: Written and signed by both before added work, past what the contract already OK'd
pf.rules.final: The city's final inspection, where the permit requires it, before the balance is asked for
pf.rules.lien_release: A lien release with the final payment, where the state's rules provide one
pf.rules.show: The license number on the listing, the times read out, the confirmation, the estimate, the contract and the receipt, where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.storm_prices: Prices from before a declared emergency, for as long as the state's rules say
pf.rules.warranty: 5 years on new siding's workmanship and 1 year on repairs (the example's); the maker's product warranty registered in the owner's name

pf.edges.weather: No siding work in rain, ice or high wind, and no caulking below the maker's lowest temperature (the example business's own limits: a 40% chance of rain or more, or under 40 degrees); a weather move never costs the customer
pf.edges.wet_wall: Rain at inspection time: a look from the ground and from inside, or a new time
pf.edges.water_getting_in: Safety steps first, then the soonest inspection time; a wall opened by a storm is wrapped the same day it is exposed
pf.edges.hidden_damage: Rotted sheathing: at the contract's price per sheet, inside the count OK'd; past it, a signed change order first
pf.edges.old_siding: Old cement-board siding that may hold asbestos, or old paint that may hold lead: the crew stops that part, the customer gets a written note, and testing and licensed removal come first, where the rules require it
pf.edges.color_match: A wood or old siding that is no longer made: the consultant checks a sample, and the customer picks a close match or a full-wall replacement; an exact match is never promised
pf.edges.meter_in_the_way: An electric meter or service line in the way: the electric company's or an electrician's job; the work day moves with no fee
pf.edges.insurance_wait: The estimate waits on the customer's insurer until its good-until date, with one reminder
pf.edges.insurance_check: The balance may wait for the insurer's check: Sam picks wait or call
pf.edges.deductible_offer: A customer or a door-knocker offers a deductible deal: answered with the plug-in's rule, never paid, waived or rebated
pf.edges.declared_emergency: The owner says which licenses lapsed, newcomers held until the owner says yes, storm-period contracts marked, prices from before it
pf.edges.permit_late: The work moves with no fee; the customer is told
pf.edges.late_delivery: Special-order siding is ordered only after the cancel window; a late delivery moves the work days with no fee, and the customer is told
pf.edges.inspection_fails: The crew fixes it and it's checked again; the balance waits
pf.edges.nobody_home: Work days: start and day-end photos
pf.edges.over_license_limit: Not offered, and the owner is told why
pf.edges.other: All other edge cases are handled the generic way

B.other: Others (a bank, an insurer, a landlord)

notes:
New profession on the REDESIGN 2 master (batch P4, Tue Oct 27 2026), built from roofer (refitted that morning, check-prof 0/0). Why roofer: siding runs the same way: an inspection at the home first, then a written estimate, a contract signed by everyone on title, a cancel window, the permit, the work days, a final walk-around and the last bill.
Unlike the roofer: never sent now (no emergency tarp; a wet or loose wall gets the soonest inspection time). Flow B S2-30 'Yes: some work is sent now' is off, S1-21's row reads 'None: every job is booked ahead', and the fact sentnow is not listed. A job is 3 work days (Mon Nov 2 to Wed Nov 4), not one.
Flow B main path (visit|none|bill): a hail-cracked wall at 74 Birch Ct. The booking is the $89 siding inspection, credited to the work if Alex signs (billed only if no contract follows); Tomas quotes the repair at the visit ($245: corner boards $165 + flashing and caulk $80); the bill comes after. Other B paths: visit|none|own, visit|card|bill, list|card|bill and list|none|bill (siding repair up to 6 boards, $179 from the list), photos|deposit|bill (soffit and fascia replacement, $640 from photos, 25% deposit $160), list|full|none (caulk and trim seal, $150 paid in full, also the yearly plan). The condition report ($199, for a sale or an insurer) is added at a visit and paid with the rest.
New siding is its own job on the master's estimate path (B8-93 '1 Signs the contract' -> B8-62 contract -> B8-63 start payment -> B8-78 cancel window, switch cancelright on in flow B only -> B9-21 stage bills). The example is Harper J.'s $2,400 garage wall re-siding in three stages ($800 / $800 / $800); Alex's own estimate in the own steps is new fiber cement siding, $14,000 (20 squares at $620 = $12,400, plus $950 for old siding removal, wrap and haul-away, plus $650 for trim, flashing and caulk).
Own steps (B): B8-x01 to B8-x04 how Alex pays (insurer first, or out of pocket; a deductible deal is refused), B8-x07 and B8-x08 the permit and any owners' association or historic approval (Wed Oct 28, due before Mon Nov 2; late: new days Mon Nov 9 or Tue Nov 10, no fee), B8-x11 to B8-x14 the work days (start, rotted sheathing inside the 8 sheets OK'd at $85 each, past 8 Alex's signed change order first, last day with the nail sweep). Own step in A: A8-x01 offers the inspection at home (it runs in flow B).
The stop words: a tree or limb through a wall, power lines down, a wall bulging, a gas smell, sparking wires. Water coming through a wall and loose siding get the safety steps, then the booking goes on, marked urgent. Old cement-board siding that may hold asbestos is never cut: B8-30's hazard note, testing and licensed removal first. Old paint on older homes: lead-safe rules as a switch. Nobody climbs a ladder to look or fix.
Licenses: the siding or contractor license is held by the company, where the state's form requires one; a job-size limit blocks a quote; window installers and showroom sellers hold their own where the state asks; S2-28 keeps 'Yes, each one', S1-60 keeps 'A license'. No state, city or law is named; no real-looking license numbers (EX- format). Not booked: a minor; a renter without the owner's OK for a contract; a job over the license limit; a home needing an association or historic approval that is not in.
Fee and money rules: the $89 inspection is the late-cancel and no-show fee (visit|card|bill) and is owed after a no to the price; deposits only after signing; the deposit and the balance follow the state's form; nothing taken before the contract is signed by everyone; the balance only after the final walk-around; the insurer's money goes to Alex; the deductible is Alex's. No tip line (S1-21's tip row is paired out). Added work is paid with the rest at the visit (D91).
Flow A is the showroom (Lee Siding Showroom, Sam's second company, consultants Priya and Leo): color consult $35 (card saved for the $20 missed-consult fee; or at home for $75), trim and accent pick $40, trim match $25, sample kit $20; color preview session $55 paid in full; full exterior plan $140 with a $40 deposit; photo siding plan $90 from photos (Sam OKs); wood siding match priced at the showroom after the $25 consult. Times are set starts. No video consult (samples are in person).
The second kind of work at sign-up is windows; the NEW kind of work added later is gutters. Staff names avoid the master's customers; no state or city; Alex is never he or she.
